ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: Which organism uses deer as food?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: This is a terrestrial food web diagram titled "TERRESTRIAL FOOD WEB". On the right side there is a deer labeled "Deer", and above the deer and slightly to the left there is a cougar labeled "Cougar". In the diagram, from near the deer there is an arrow upward pointing to the cougar. Reasoning: In a food web, arrows indicate energy or food flowing from the organism that is eaten to the organism that eats it. Therefore, the arrow from Deer to Cougar indicates that Cougar eats deer.
